headline: Thailand October CPI Inflation Rises to 3.9% on Energy Cost Escalation
summary: Thailand's headline consumer price index rose 3.9% year-on-year in October to reach a 45-month high. High fuel prices accounted for 56% of total inflation gains.
why: Thailand's headline CPI influences Bank of Thailand interest rate decisions and national consumer spending power.

impacts.name: Thailand
impacts.why: Energy price spikes accelerate overall cost of living and pressure retail sales metrics.
